'''Brektate''' was the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' at the time of its crash on the crystalline [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. Brektate died in the crash of the ship.

*''[[The Isis Coordinates]]'' {{1st}}
